description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the home screen of an educational app. It displays a welcome header, a progress summary, and a horizontally scrolling list of lessons, including navigation to lesson details.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the main screen with lesson suggestions.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the loading and display of lessons, including fetching data and building the UI.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontal
classes.description: A stateless widget representing individual lesson cards with progress indicator and tap handling.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers data loading.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches lesson list from repository and updates state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the home screen, including header, progress, and lessons list.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds individual lesson card UI, with tap handler to navigate to lesson details.
